integrity: One all-dimension theorem and one matching proof. Self-review only; no independent certification or invented publication date.
scientific_limitations: For synchronous binary parity updates on the distance-three Hamming graph only, either excluding or including the updated site. Not an arbitrary shell or field. General all-dimension proof rests on alternating-form normal form, tensor homology, and square-zero algebra; direct finite checks are corroborative. Coding-theoretic priority beyond inspected sources remains open.
title: Complete binary dynamics of third-distance Hamming-cube parity maps
